color.evidence: Tokens match DESIGN.md. Audit contrast_fail_count 0, distinct_bg_colors 5, dominant hue 225, cta_hues [218,218], purple_primary false. --action #013ea8 vs --blue #0154a7 remain 22 G-steps apart, same hue.
strengths: Seven named tokens with blue-tinted mist, not default grey.
Zero contrast failures; on-dark contact inverts CTAs to paper on --deep.
One radius, no shadows, no purple/gradient-text palette

issues.problem: --action #013ea8 and --blue #0154a7 both measure hue 218. Filled quote, outline header CTA, and See specification all read as the same blue.
issues.fix: Set --action to #012056 for filled .btn / .bar a+a only; keep --blue #0154a7 for links.

issues.problem: Named 7-colour system leaks hex: input #5c6b78, error #a4260c, on-dark #c9d3e0.
issues.fix: Add --field, --on-dark, --press, --danger to :root and replace those literals.

issues.problem: Glass is rgba(255,255,255,.78) blur(16px). Over tanker banners the bar still reads as solid paper.
issues.fix: On pages with .pagehead, lower alpha to .62 so the tanker wash tints the bar.

spacing_rhythm.evidence: Audit spacing_grid_adherence 100; spacing_distinct 9; distinct_radii 1; distinct_shadows 0. Scale 4/8/12/16/24/32/48/80. Off-scale: footer padding 6.5rem / skyline 7.5rem. quality_fold lab photo taller than copy.
strengths: 100% 4px-grid adherence with one 4px radius and no card shadows.
Consistent s7/s8 section padding and 5/6 column gap.
Mosaic 8px seams vs 48-80px section gaps; .place 24px band is a real rhythm change.

issues.problem: Lab photograph fills the left column; two short paragraphs leave a tall white void under the copy.
issues.fix: Cap the photo at max-height 22rem object-fit cover, or move the batch-check table into the text column.

issues.problem: Your requirement and Contact details use the same 1.5-2.4rem clamp as marketing h2s.
Left column is a single h2 with no supporting line; right column is three list rows.
issues.fix: Set this section to padding-block var(--s6) at 1024px and put a one-line p under the h2.

issues.problem: Footer padding 6.5rem and ::after height 7.5rem are off the 4-80 scale. Privacy sits on the skyline.
issues.fix: Change footer to padding var(--s6) 0 var(--s8); footer::after height var(--s8).
